source_nesting.rule: Highest available original3km nest, parent9km fallback; no outside-domain field substitution

wind_coordinate_frame: Earth east/north/up m/s; actual destaggered3D WRF winds rotated with actualCOSALPHA/SINALPHA
cloud_quantity: Actual WRF CLDFRA: separate weather fraction, not theSO2 colour or a random texture. Its microphysics/radiation calculation remains the original weather model.
time_policy: Weather values are hourly instantaneous snapshots; interpolate scalars/vectors, never RGB frames. Rain is the actual cumulativeRAINNC+RAINC difference over each hour.
vertical_policy: Bilinear original-column values/heights followed by actual-height linear interpolation at16 AGL centers. Below first mass level hold its diagnostic value; this is not a measured10m surface wind or a replacement for the solver surface layer.
resolution_policy: 64x64 display sampling over the full requestedROI, not finer-weather physics. Original3km/9km50-level files remain unchanged.
gas_wet_loss_policy: SO2 wet removal must use actual native cumulative wet-deposition fields; rain graphics do not manually delete gas or change opacity.
weather_implementation: Original compiled NCAR WRFv4.7.1 CPU12MPI3x4 with the exact original matched-reference physical configuration; nativeFLEX CPU8 retains disclosed diagnostic counter/geometry repairs. GPU used for independent plume and saved-field work, not weather.
weather_qualification_note: Qualified original-native reference continuation and complete frozen weather do not relabel the preserved failed GPU/hybrid2mm comparison asPASS.
